items.title: AI and Readable APIs
items.raw_excerpt: In the AI age the importance of readable APIs goes up, as this can mean the difference between not reading the code because it’s too much, and easily reading it to verify it is correct because it’s tiny. But we need to be careful of this, and notice that this is what is happening.

items.title: Gulama – Security-first open-source AI agent (OpenClaw alternative)
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN, I'm a security engineer with 15+ years in enterprise security. After watching OpenClaw explode to 180K stars while binding to 0.0.0.0 by default, shipping no encryption, and accumulating 512 CVEs — I decided to build what I think a personal AI agent should look like when security comes first. Gulama is an open-source personal AI agent with 15+ security mechanisms built into the core: - AES-256-GCM encryption for all credentials and memories (never plaintext)
- Sandboxed execution via bubblewrap/Docker (same sandbox Anthropic uses for Claude Code)
- Ed25519-signed skills (no unsigned code runs — unlike ClawHub's 230+ malicious skills)
- Cedar-inspired policy engine for deterministic authorization
- Canary tokens for prompt injection detection
- Egress filtering + DLP to prevent data

items.title: 人工智能热潮引发存储芯片抢购 芯片短缺愈演愈烈
items.raw_excerpt: 包括埃隆·马斯克、蒂姆·库克在内的科技行业领袖纷纷警告一场全球性危机正在酝酿：存储芯片短缺开始冲击利润、打乱企业规划，推高从笔记本电脑、智能手机到汽车和数据中心等各类产品的价格，而且供应紧张只会愈演愈烈。今年初以来，特斯拉、苹果等十多家大型企业暗示DRAM这种几乎所有科技产品都要用到的存储芯片严重短缺，势将制约生产。库克表示，这将压缩iPhone的利润率。美光科技称短缺程度“前所未见”。马斯克甚至表示特斯拉将不得不自建芯片工厂。“如果我们不建芯片工厂，就会遇到芯片瓶颈，”马斯克上月末表示。造成存储芯片供应紧张的根本原因在于人工智能(AI)数据中心的建设浪潮。由于英伟达的AI芯片需要配备大量高带宽内存，存储芯片行业的可用产能遭到挤占，以至用于手机、个人电脑等传统领域的存储芯片也面临严重短缺。Bernstein半导体行业分析师Mark Li警告称，内存价格正在呈现“抛物线式”上涨。虽然这将为三星、美光和SK海力士带来丰厚利润，但电子行业的其他领域将在未来数月付出沉重代价。

title_i18n.zh: 人工智能热潮引发存储芯片抢购 芯片短缺愈演愈烈

title_i18n.es: La fiebre de la inteligencia artificial desata la compra frenética de chips de memoria, agravando la escasez de semiconductores.

excerpt_i18n.en: Technology leaders including Elon Musk and Tim Cook have warned of an impending global crisis: a shortage of memory chips is beginning to erode profits, disrupt corporate planning, and drive up prices for everything from laptops and smartphones to cars and data centers, with supply constraints only expected to worsen. Since the beginning of this year, over a dozen major companies such as Tesla and Apple have indicated that a severe shortage of DRAM—a type of memory chip essential to nearly all tech products—will inevitably constrain production. Cook stated that this will squeeze iPhone profit margins. Micron Technology described the shortage as "unprecedented." Musk even suggested that Tesla may have to build its own chip factories. "If we don’t build chip factories, we’ll face chip bottlenecks," Musk said late last month. The root cause of the memory chip supply crunch lies in the wave of artificial intelligence (AI) data center construction. As Nvidia’s AI chips require large amounts of high-bandwidth memory, the available capacity in the memory chip industry is being squeezed, leading to severe shortages even for chips used in traditional areas like mobile phones and personal computers. Bernstein semiconductor analyst Mark Li warned that memory prices are rising in a "parabolic" fashion. While this will bring substantial profits to Samsung, Micron, and SK Hynix, other sectors of the electronics industry will pay a heavy price in the coming months.
